name: Thinkmorph-cube-benchmark
description: Thinkmorph-cube-benchmark evaluates a model's ability to interpret and reason about cube-like 3D objects and their transformations from visual (and/or textual) inputs. It focuses on spatial reasoning, morphological changes, and object-centric inference over short scenarios. The benchmark is intended to measure precision in visual perception and spatial/relational reasoning rather than open-ended generation.
reputation: A niche dataset published on Hugging Face with limited but growing adoption among visual/spatial reasoning researchers.
